study.question: Does removing per-impression coarse-bin-wide recency from the compact within-bin feature improve access to target-match/action age association beyond both frozen sources, the centered incumbent, and active duplicated-evidence controls?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: r18 and r19 continuous compact heads lost to duplicated histograms. r20 centered within-bin means reached AUC0.6225936505 vs histogram0.6223213395, uncentered0.6224434948 and zero0.6221217552, but exceed the prior duplicate best0.6225086647 by only0.0000849858 at seed42. No repetition or uncertainty interval establishes a mechanism. A cell mean mixes overall within-bin age with cell-specific age association. Removing the shared per-bin mean may make conditional evidence more accessible to the same readout; a global-bin replacement tests the competing marginal-recency explanation. This is a deterministic representation contrast, not new raw information, fitted orthogonalization or an independence guarantee.

nearest_work.difference: Retain its frozen64-cell time coordinate and second readout. Replace fixed midpoint centering by a per-impression global coarse-bin mean subtraction. Observed and histogram cells reproduce parent functions at the same weights; no new learned parameters.
Keep all exchangeable representations and add no event inputs. Study information access in the already appended compact residual head; shared grouped-history ancestry remains a redundancy risk.

Inherit the bias-free contextual residual architecture and count/freshness motivation; previous absolute exponential moments failed against local active duplicates. This proposal tests joint versus marginal sub-bin age using supplied category/brand/action fields.

DIN uses learned ad-conditioned event activation and deliberately unnormalized weighted pooling. The local baseline is a softmax-normalized field adaptation, not exact DIN. New intervention uses fixed match/action/age means and a bias-free residual, without learned event attention. No priority claim.
README verifies category, brand and behavior availability without item identity. Publisher paper unavailable through this authorized source; no detailed DMR equivalence or novelty claim.

inherited_components: All exchangeable_joint embeddings and count/grouped, histogram, moment, field, identity, context, repeat, overlap and exchangeable transition readouts
First duplicated-histogram compact residual and second bias-free RMS-gated64-input residual from the current incumbent; all train from scratch
Four exclusive target category/brand match groups x four actions x four fixed coarse age bins; the same within-bin log coordinate and bounded tail coordinate as r20
Frozen information, causal prefix, training, seeds, scorer and validation-only boundary
study.proposed_difference: For cell c=(match group,action,bin b), let n_c and mu_c be its count and mean r20 within-bin coordinate, H_c=log1p(n_c)/log129, and mu_b=sum_c_in_b(n_c*mu_c)/max(1,sum_c_in_b n_c). Compute O=H*(2mu_c-1), G=H*(2mu_b-1), R=O-G=2H*(mu_c-mu_b), and H. Feed only R(candidate), G(marginal replacement), O(exact observed-function control), or H(active duplicated-evidence control) to the unchanged second residual. Empty cells are exactly zero. Global mean pools across both semantic and action axes within one impression and bin, using visible events only. Compute every alternative identically in all arms. No additional branch, parameters, RNG, input, learned statistics, optimization or loss change.
predictions: R beats G and H and exceeds O as well as both frozen source bests in full validation AUC if isolating conditional age association aids access. Failure to beat O makes the proposed improvement unsuccessful even if R beats weaker sources.
If G matches or exceeds O/R, the marginal-recency explanation remains viable; if H matches them, redundant evidence/readout geometry remains viable.

At common weights O reproduces the r20 mean function, H reproduces the histogram function, O=G+R to float tolerance, raw count-weighted residuals sum to zero within each bin, and a fixed age-swap witness holds histograms/global means/parent logits fixed while changing R. These certify access/algebra, not predictive usefulness.

No efficiency claim without measured allocated GPU/wall time, peak memory and full inference throughput/p50/p95 relative to both sources. Parameter allocation should remain17196083 total/17078688 embedding/117395 dense; second head4256.
falsifiers: Conditional variant does not beat observed and marginal alternatives and active histogram duplication under repeated paired seeds, or source best exchangeable_joint remains stronger.
Advantage appears only against zero or lower-capacity controls, is reproduced by H/G, disappears across seeds, or is offset by an inferior quality-cost frontier.

Source-level or host diagnostics show information leakage, nonfinite logits, changed parent allocation, failed O/H reproduction, count mismatch, nonzero empty features, loss of permutation/padding invariance, or direct feature/algebra errors above1e-5. Do not repair failure by changing frozen data/scoring contracts.
alternative_explanations: The r20 lead is seed variation or repeated adaptive validation selection; one seed has no independent replication or user-cluster uncertainty interval.
Subtraction changes input magnitude/sign and optimization geometry; R need not be independent of counts, target identity or global recency. Equal parameter count does not equal effective capacity.

The global mean includes the focal cell, producing self-inclusion and sparsity effects; singleton-bin histories give R=0 by design. This intervention does not isolate semantic from action association separately.
All parent branches and embeddings co-adapt during scratch training. Feature decomposition O=G+R does not imply an additive decomposition of trained logits or causal marginal contributions.
Shared ancestry may make the sources redundant; truncated128-event support and undocumented static-snapshot dates limit transfer.
Diagnostics originate in candidate code on the first512 validation impressions, expensive checks16; they are not independent population mechanism estimates.
